title: Seven Sins
description: A room about contradiction, consequence, and what happens when a story refuses a single moral.

hotspots.label: Threshold
hotspots.dialogue: The threshold is not a doorway so much as a warning: looking changes what you can see.

hotspots.label: Mirror
hotspots.dialogue: The mirror gives you the wrong answer first. The point is not to sell you the answer; it is to make you question the frame.
